nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=68 beats='Monday morning, Miri opens the henhouse gate. Pip, the smallest hen, is missing. A single blue feather lies on the straw. Clover and Big Bess cluck uneasily.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Inside the warm henhouse. Empty nest boxes, scattered straw. Pip’s water dish is tipped over. Clover pecks at Miri’s boot as if asking for help.'>>

choices.label: Tap the back wall and listen

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=69 beats='Miri lifts the straw in each nest box. One holds a warm brown egg, but no Pip. A faint cluck seems to come from below the coop floor.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Miri lies flat and shines her torch under the coop. Two tiny eyes blink back. Pip has wedged herself under a pipe and cannot move.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=71 beats='Miri carefully slides her hand under Pip and lifts. Pip is unhurt, just stuck. She shakes her feathers and pecks Miri's finger gratefully.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=68 beats='Miri runs inside and brings back Mr. Kim, the caretaker. With a long stick, he pries the pipe so Pip can wiggle free.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=67 beats='The back yard is quiet save for a distant lawnmower. Under the porch steps, a small feathered shape huddles.'>>

choices.label: Sprinkle chicken feed to lure her

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='The feathered shape is Pip, fast asleep in a coil of old hose. Miri picks her up gently and carries her back to the coop.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=69 beats='Miri scatters a handful of chicken feed near the porch. A curious hen appears from behind the trash can, but it is Clover, not Pip.'>>

choices.label: Return to the coop to check again

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=66 beats='Back at the coop, Miri opens the gate wearily. A small red shape pecks at the feeder. Pip is already back, as if she never left.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Behind the grain sacks, Miri finds only a dusty spiderweb. But a trail of bright blue feathers leads toward the back door.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=69 beats='The blue feather trail leads around the coop, across the sandbox, and stops at a broken plank in the school fence. Beyond: the owl tree.'>>

choices.label: Call from here one more time

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Beyond the fence, Pip is perched on a low branch of the owl tree, preening. She seems perfectly content. Miri lures her down with a handful of grain.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=63 beats='Miri calls Pip's name into the trees. A distant cluck answers, but it fades away. Pip is somewhere out there, but Miri cannot reach her.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Miri presses her ear to the coop wall. A soft cluck! She taps back. The cluck comes from a loose board near the waterer bucket.'>>

choices.label: Get the torch from the shed

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=71 beats='Miri pries the loose board open. Behind it, a hollow space holds a nest of soft feathers and Pip herself, snoozing soundly on three eggs.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Miri covers the nest gently and leaves Pip to her eggs. She will tell Ms. Chen in the morning. Pip is safe and happy.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=68 beats='Miri runs to fetch Ms. Chen. Together they check the secret nest. Ms. Chen helps Miri put a soft barrier so Pip is safe from drafts.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=67 beats='Miri cups her hands and calls Pip's name across the windy yard. Leaves skitter. No red comb appears. Big Bess follows Miri like a guard.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=65 beats='Miri calls Pip's name three times, each time louder. For a moment, she hears a faint rustle in the bushes by the compost bin.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=60 beats='Miri calls Pip's name one last tim. Then she hears a cheerful buck from inside the coop!'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Miri tiptoes towards the compost bin. Behind it, a hole under the fence leads to the wild meadow. A single feather hangs on the wire.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Miri crawls into the meadow. The grass is tall. She spots Pip drinking from a puddle. Pip runs to her, and Miri carries her back.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=69 beats='Miri runs to the shed, finds a net, and hurries back. She gently scoops Pip from the meadow before Pip can dart into the deep woods.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=67 beats='Clover waddles toward the old apple tree. Under its branches, the earth is scratched. A single yellow feather sticks out of the dirt.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Miri scrapes the dirt with her hands. Two inches down, she finds an old bone, not a hen. Clover clucks impatiently and struts toward the garden.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Clover waddles to the lettuce patch and pecs at the ground. Under a rhubarb leaf, a smal fluff of red feathers stirs. It's Pip!'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=68 beats='Miri finds Ms. Chen watering the classroom plants. Ms. Chen puts down her watering can and follows Miri to the apple tree.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='The wooden garden gate swings with a creak. A hen-sized gap shows through the fence. Muddy three-toed prints lead into the vegetable patch.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=69 beats='Through the gap, Miri steps into the neighbor's garden. A hen-sized hole under the fence leads to a burlap sack. The sack twitches.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Inside the burlap sack, Pip has found a pile of corn and cannot resist. Miri scoops her up and carries her home.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=69 beats='The neighbor, Mr. Yusuf, opens the door. He says he saw a smal red hen scraching near the shed and shooed her back toward the school.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=71 beats='The old toolshed has cobwebs and a broken rake. Behind an upended wheelbarrow, something white and reddish catches Miri's eye.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=67 beats='Behind the wheelbarrow, Pip huddles in a nest of rags. She has laid a tiny egg. Miri wraps her in a towel and carries her home.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='Miri kneels and listens. A soft cluck comes from inside an old paint can. She tips it gently, empty. Pip must be elsewher.'>>

choices.label: Run to the yard to call
